bio_am: Գանձակեցի նշանաւոր հայդուկ, ինկաւ Ասկերանի սարերուն վրայ՝ Ղարաբաղի կռիւներուն մէջ (1920)։
bio_en: Mikayel Badalkeokhian, known as Deli (Dali) Ghazar, was a hero from Ganja who spent his youth in fighting and became one of the ARF's leading band commanders. In the Armenian-Tatar clashes of 1905 he made his name as a daring operative. In 1914 he joined the volunteer regiments, and in 1918, as the Russian army abandoned the front, he was chosen to lead a force of two thousand. He fell heroically on the hills of Askeran in the last fighting in Karabakh in spring 1920.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Not the same as Deli Ghazo (Ghazar Tarkhanian, #256).
